create_logger_get_logger: create a transformers logger instance with a custom name using get_logger
set_verbosity_configure_logging: set the transformers logging verbosity level to debug, info, warning, or error
enable_tqdm_progress_bar: enable or disable tqdm progress bars in transformers with enable_progress_bar and disable_progress_bar
add_tqdm_hook_customize_progress: set a custom tqdm hook via set_tqdm_hook to customize progress bar creation behavior
add_handler_custom_logging: add, remove, enable, or disable logging handlers on the transformers root logger
